name: DiceBear
description: Modular deterministic SVG avatar library with 61 styles (core @dicebear/core + styles); also a free HTTP API.

restrictions: Code is MIT but each style has its own licence: 42 CC0 1.0, 14 CC BY 4.0 (attribution), 1 MIT (Icons), 4 'artist's own terms' (Avataaars, Avataaars Neutral, Bottts, Bottts Neutral)
Only bundle/recommend CC0 styles by default; CC BY styles need credit, artist-terms styles need a manual read
license.notes: @dicebear/core 10.7.0 (2026-08-26); @dicebear/collection 9.4.2 (2026-03-19) on the previous major. Counts from the DiceBear licences page, 2026-11-14.

cost.notes: Local use free; HTTP API see dicebear-http-api.

verdictReason: Richest ecosystem, MIT code, but style licences vary; wrap per-style with CC0-only allow-list after MVP (size to be measured).
